❖ Senior product and project management professional with extensive experience delivering end-to-end banking transformation initiatives,
WORK EXPERIENCE
Deutsche Bank | Assistant Vice President | Project Manager Jan 2025 – Present
AI Enabled Delivery - DB Lumina
❖ Spearheaded strategic account growth and enterprise AI transformation by leading the vision, strategy, and development of DB Lumina (Deutsche Bank–Google Cloud AI platform), leveraging Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Generative AI, OCR, intelligent automation, and cloud-native technologies. Collaborated with executive stakeholders, sales, pre-sales, and engineering teams to drive AI adoption, define transformation roadmaps, deliver high-value RFPs/SOWs, and unlock multimillion-dollar business growth opportunities.
Nostro Management Delivery - CTB
❖ Leading end-to-end delivery ownership of complex, multi-domain client programs, covering strategy, execution, governance, and post-
implementation support, while ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, quality, budget, and operational KPIs.
❖ Managing large-scale, cross-functional global teams across engineering, QA, architecture, DevOps, and business functions, while driving
high-performance delivery across onshore, offshore, and nearshore models.
❖ Establishing and governing program governance frameworks, ensuring executive-level transparency, proactive risk tracking, and alignment
with CXO/VP stakeholders.
❖ Serving as primary client engagement lead, translating business challenges into delivery strategies while managing senior stakeholder
relationships and driving sustained account satisfaction and strategic alignment.
❖ Owning financial governance of banking portfolios, including revenue recognition, forecasting, margin improvement, and corrective action
planning, while ensuring strong commercial performance and profitability.
❖ Driving delivery optimization and cost efficiency initiatives, leveraging automation, resource optimization, and operating model
improvements to reduce OPEX and enhance productivity across programs.
❖ Leading risk, dependency, and escalation management, implementing structured mitigation strategies and contingency planning to ensure
delivery continuity in high-pressure environments.
Wells Fargo | Senior Business Execution Consultant / Business Development Manager April 2024 – January 2025 Strategic execution leader driving financial crime transformation, transaction monitoring optimization, and regulatory-aligned data governance across AML and correspondent banking programs.
❖ Led end-to-end delivery of real-time and batch Transaction Monitoring (TM) capabilities within CTB programs, ensuring complete data
lineage, AML compliance, and regulatory traceability.
❖ Orchestrated risk-based TM enhancements by integrating customer risk scoring models, improving detection accuracy and significantly
reducing false positives.
❖ Established enterprise data governance controls across TM platforms, ensuring data integrity, quality assurance, and alignment with
regulatory and enterprise standards.
❖ Directed cross-functional delivery across AML, Fraud, Technology, and Data Science teams to implement ML-driven anomaly detection and
strengthen fraud prevention frameworks.
❖ Facilitated stakeholder governance through SteerCo sessions, product demos, and requirement walkthroughs to drive continuous platform
enhancement and business alignment.
NatWest Group | Strategy / Project Manager (Financial Crime, TM, Correspondent Banking, Trade Finance) August 2018 – April 2024 Transformation leader delivering AML modernization, cost optimization, digital banking initiatives, and enterprise data strategy across global banking platforms.
❖ Delivered end-to-end AML transaction monitoring enhancements, reducing false positives and improving investigative efficiency,
contributing to ~8% cost reduction.
❖ Executed Agile-based MVP delivery using data-driven business analysis across multi-stakeholder banking ecosystems. ❖ Led resource optimization and budget forecasting initiatives, reducing operating costs by 20% while improving profitability by 15%. ❖ Designed enterprise data lineage and governance frameworks using Python, strengthening data quality, controls, and traceability from
source to consumption.
❖ Produced executive-level artefacts including BRDs, FSDs, use cases, defect triage reports, and ExCo presentations for decision governance. ❖ Strengthened risk profiling frameworks across input feeds in collaboration with first and second line of defense teams. ❖ Aligned data dictionaries and mapping frameworks with entity resolution models to ensure consistency across releases and business
validations.
❖ Led global payments modernization initiative transitioning SWIFT messaging from MT to MX (ISO 20022).
Digital Banking Transformation (Retail & Commercial Banking) Digital transformation lead driving end-to-end digitization of customer journeys across retail and commercial banking platforms, enabling scalable, paperless, and revenue-generating digital ecosystems.
❖ Led end-to-end digitization of customer journeys across retail and commercial banking products by modernizing legacy processes into
secure digital channels (Online Banking, Bankline, and mobile platforms).
❖ Defined and executed digital channel strategy to transition paper-based banking processes into paperless workflows, improving operational
efficiency and customer experience.
❖ Launched 5 digital banking initiatives contributing to 5% incremental revenue growth and 92% cost reduction through automation and
digital adoption.
❖ Partnered with cross-functional business, technology, and product teams to ensure seamless delivery of customer-facing digital capabilities
across multiple banking brands.
Business Analytics & Insights Transformation Analytics transformation lead enabling data-driven decision-making across retail and commercial banking through advanced insights, customer segmentation, and executive-level reporting frameworks.
❖ Developed enterprise-wide analytical frameworks to derive actionable insights on customer behavior, digital adoption, and product
performance across retail and commercial banking portfolios.
❖ Built customer segmentation models and digital usage analytics to support targeted business strategies and revenue optimization initiatives. ❖ Leveraged internal and external data sources to solve complex business problems and enable data-driven decision-making across
leadership teams.
❖ Designed and delivered executive dashboards and visualization frameworks using structured hypothesis-driven analysis and SWOT-based
storytelling techniques.
Governance & Implementation Manager (Pollinate Program) Governance and implementation lead for enterprise merchant data platform integrating multi-system transaction intelligence across banking products.
❖ Led end-to-end implementation of “Pollinate” platform integrating Enterprise Data Hub (EDH) with upstream/downstream banking
systems for consolidated merchant transaction intelligence.
❖ Defined solution architecture and data flow design across distributed systems ensuring scalability, security, and compliance. ❖ Established global governance frameworks covering third-party controls, implementation plans, release management, and operational
readiness.
❖ Managed change governance, stakeholder alignment, and execution reporting including schedules, MCRs, and event readiness
documentation.
HCL Technologies | Associate Project Manager August 2007 – August 2018 Technology and delivery leader managing global client engagements across banking and financial services, delivering large-scale transformation and system modernization programs.
❖
Improved customer engagement metrics by 30% through modernization and replacement of legacy platforms with optimized application ecosystems.
❖ Led teams of 15+ across program, portfolio, and delivery management functions ensuring successful execution of enterprise initiatives. ❖ Drove cost optimization across investment banking and wealth management applications, reducing annual application-level spend. ❖ Delivered technology and business solutions for global clients including Pearson, Deutsche Bank, UBS, and Citi across India, Singapore, and
